I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from Tobias's post in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he had flagged it to support on #8841.

The ticket may not be for Marrow Fieldworks. Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two because of a Central team handoff note: it says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5. But it doesn't say who took it over. So in the reply I asked Tobias to confirm before Pree's call.

I only used things Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the team's public files.
